question: Which Indian political leader was awarded with Bhutan’s highest civilian honour called the Order of the Druk Gyalpo in December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In December 2021, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** was conferred with Bhutan’s highest civilian honor, **the Order of the Druk Gyalpo**.
 
• The honor was announced by Bhutan's King **Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck** in recognition of PM Modi’s support and contributions to strengthening India-Bhutan ties.
 
• PM Modi’s leadership in fostering close bilateral relations and cooperation between India and Bhutan during the COVID-19 pandemic was specifically lauded.
 
• The Order of the Druk Gyalpo is a rare and prestigious honor given to individuals who significantly contribute to Bhutan’s welfare and international relations.
 
• PM Modi expressed his gratitude and reaffirmed India’s commitment to its relationship with Bhutan, a trusted neighbor and ally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Bhutan Relations:**

 
 
• India and Bhutan share strong bilateral ties based on mutual trust, cultural similarities, and economic cooperation.
 
• India is Bhutan’s largest trading partner and supports Bhutan in areas like hydropower development, education, and healthcare.
 
• The friendship treaty signed in 1949 was revised in 2007 to reflect mutual sovereignty and independence.
 
 
 
• **Order of the Druk Gyalpo:**
 
 
• It is Bhutan’s highest civilian honor, reserved for individuals who have made exceptional contributions to the nation.
 
• The award symbolizes Bhutan’s gratitude and recognition of remarkable leadership or service.
 
 
 
• **COVID-19 Cooperation:**
 
 
• India supplied COVID-19 vaccines to Bhutan under its Vaccine Maitri initiative, strengthening regional solidarity.
 
• Bhutan praised India’s assistance during the pandemic, including medical supplies and expertise.
 
 
 
• **Bhutan’s Monarchy:**
 
 
• Bhutan is governed by a constitutional monarchy led by King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck.
 
• The monarchy plays a significant role in Bhutan’s development and international relations.
